text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and I head into town to watch a kendo tournament.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory uses her kendo experience to provide passionate commentary, all the way up to the finals.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Man, that nukidou! Such a perfect body strike! The final match definitely lived up to the hype! Well then, wanna get go—
W-wait! You there!
Pant, pant… You're Bamboo, right?! Do you remember me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! Didn't you just win the tournament?! Do we know each other?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Ah! Don't tell me! Did we used to train at the same dojo?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a surprise! I didn't expect to run into you here!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You moved away really suddenly, right? I was so shocked because you left without saying anything!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sorry about that. You had just started racing and you seemed so busy. But also… I couldn't bring myself to face you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text: …Back then, I wasn't able to be the person that you wanted me to be.

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: …And then after that, my dad swore to meet him again in next year's finals!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Isn't that so cool?! I want a rival like that too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text: But you were so strong. You progressed so quickly that nobody else could compete! Including me.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text: I couldn't tell you back then, but I can now. Back when you started racing… I thought it was because all of us at the dojo were too weak for you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: N-no way! That's not true!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text: …I was so determined to get stronger! Strong enough to beat you! So… what do you say? Are you willing to spar with me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'd be happy to!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They stop short of hitting each other because they aren't wearing any guards, but their match is so intense I hardly notice!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Holy cow! You've sure gotten strong!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Hehe. I guess we've both grown a lot since back then.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Childhood Friend
text_block_list.text: I watch all your races, so I've seen you getting better as well. We might be on different paths now, but let's both keep pushing ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Two rivals, fiercely competing as we push forward on our separate paths!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and her childhood friend exchange a firm handshake before parting ways.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That was sooo intense! A reunion! A rematch! A rekindled friendship! And to top it off, a vow of rivalry! Talk about red-hot! I'M BURNING UP!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! I gotta pack all this passion into my legs and blast it all out in a run!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Faster! Keep… moving… forward!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (I know this feeling—this irresistible feeling boiling up inside me… I've felt it before, a long time ago…)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (That's it. No matter how much I trained, I could never get rid of it… My heart burned so hot, I was running before I even realized it!)

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: …Ngh. Further! I gotta go further! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff! Ahhh! This feels incredible!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: (Running feels great… That's it… Racing! I bet that's where I can find a rival…)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (And I really did! I found the best rivals I could ask for! And above all…)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Listen to this! I remembered something amazing when I was running!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I left kendo for racing so I could find the best rivals ever! And now I feel like that dream is becoming reality!
choice_data_list: Then I bet beating them would really make your dream come true!
Let's stay on track and keep pressing forward.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's get my old friend—no! Let's get everyone in the whole world on board with my dream!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's make it happen together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory speaks with red-hot passion… Yet again, my desire to support her on her racing journey has been renewed.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course! If I hadn't entered the world of racing, I wouldn't have met Oguri and all of my other rivals. Not only that…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't have met you! You can look forward to a whole lot of red-hot running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory speaks with red-hot passion… Yet again, my desire to support her on her racing journey has been renewed.
